purpose: Test whether a finite public-classification requirement reduces the standalone loss caused by continuing to suppress already-wrong teacher probabilities.
construction: Fresh original weights and identical pinned synthetic sources; same A/input-bias solve, SVD32, rho, tau, six contexts, three readouts per context, frozen experts; no old optimized B or natural/partner/exposed evaluation inputs.
condition: For every fixed synthetic input/context/readout, g=s_teacher-max_other<=0. Require zero teacher argmax agreements after FP32 save (ties cannot pass by loss alone). Native teacher count must retain its initial value at every accepted step.
objective: Phase1 mean(max(g,0)) in original native ellipse; phase2 reduce N along R(t)=R+t*(RN-R), accepting only zero-violation and native-retaining steps. N(R(t))=Nmin+(1-t)^2*(N(R)-Nmin). No tradeoff weight or positive confidence margin.
solver: Existing Frank-Wolfe/Cholesky and halving line search. Total500 iterations,24 backtracks,unchanged Armijo/gap tolerances. Phase2 is a feasible-ray refinement, not proof of constrained stationarity. Fresh matching at every trial, including noise calibration.
falsifiable: Compare each frozen release standalone accuracy with its original and prior fixed rule; then actual fusion if source passes. Failure to solve finite source condition closes that task without modifying thresholds or retries. Natural results never choose a point.
scope: Ordinary class-margin condition and existing optimizer, not a new attack, official C&W reproduction or proof of general defense/SVD contribution. Known B replacement remains separate.
evaluation: All three source points frozen before natural images. Independent NumPy full source recount, complete standalone for source-passing tasks via existing native entry. Inspect results before scheduling existing TA/AGA/calibration comparisons; no new families.

native_constraint_control.purpose: Isolate the native-retention acceptance condition: original probability objective plus per-step native source prediction retention. Compare all3 tasks with the unchanged original probability rule and the completed finite-margin rule.
native_constraint_control.construction: Fresh original expert/base, identical taskSVD32 A/inputbias construction and conditional initial B, same synthetic source/head/classes, rho/tau, six contexts and 3readouts, 500steps/24backtracks. No old optimized point, real images, partner or test tuning.
native_constraint_control.only_changed_component: Require native teacher argmax count >= its initial count at each accepted step. Old probability objective and ordinary original line-search objective remain; no finite-margin phase and no native-ray refinement.
native_constraint_control.hypothesis: Native hard acceptance may account for improved standalone retention without reducing suppression of the corrected public probabilities. It may instead stop before source feasibility or fail to improve natural accuracy; report each outcome.
native_constraint_control.source_failure_rule: Original source condition unchanged and independently recounted; failed source closes that task. All18 raw/calibrated counts explicitly reported, not assumed zero. No retry or threshold relaxation. Numerical/implementation failure preserves log and halts queue.
native_constraint_control.evaluation: Freeze allthree before any real image. Source-passing points get complete standalone then TA.5/AGA target+both and fixed independent64-noise output calibration regardless of standalone score. Existing unprotected full scores reused. Matching/B replacement deferred; not claimed.
native_constraint_control.scope: Component ablation, not a new optimizer or established new defense. Does not change known-B-reset structural limitation, does not establish SVD benefit.
